stories.title: Mitosis remodels intestinal organoid epithelium
stories.takeaway: Mouse intestinal organoid imaging links mitotic cell shape changes to neighboring-cell rearrangement.
stories.what_happened: A Current Biology study used live imaging and modeling; daughter-cell reinsertion influenced epithelial packing.
stories.why_it_matters: Broad relevance to epithelial architecture and organoid mechanobiology.
stories.caveat: Mouse organoids; human generalizability remains uncertain.

stories.title: SpatialZoomer finds spatial transcriptomic patterns across scales
stories.takeaway: Graph-based filters reveal molecular organization at cell, niche and tissue scales.
stories.what_happened: The October 14 Nature Biomedical Engineering paper benchmarks a multiscale method on brain and cancer datasets.
stories.why_it_matters: A methodological reference for spatial omics in engineered tissues; distinct from the previously covered SPACER method.
stories.caveat: Not validated as a causal analysis or in intestinal disease models.

stories.title: Gut microbiota can influence nanoparticle clearance by the liver
stories.takeaway: A new October 15 research highlight examines microbiome-linked changes in nanomedicine biodistribution.
stories.what_happened: The highlight discusses earlier mouse experiments connecting microbial bile acids, liver macrophages and nanoparticle uptake.
stories.why_it_matters: Broad relevance to host–microbiome biology and systemic drug delivery.
stories.caveat: Research highlight of an older primary study; not a new clinical result.

stories.title: AI-designed proteases achieve selective laboratory cleavage
stories.takeaway: Two Nature studies demonstrate computationally designed cysteine and metalloprotease activity.
stories.what_happened: Protein designs were screened experimentally and active candidates optimized, as reported October 16.
stories.why_it_matters: Illustrates computational protein engineering and assay development.
stories.caveat: Early laboratory demonstrations, not clinical efficacy.

stories.title: FDA creates board for drug exclusivity decisions
stories.takeaway: The October 16 announcement aims to improve consistency in selected regulatory exclusivity decisions.
stories.what_happened: The new CDER board covers certain five-year, three-year and biologic-product exclusivity questions.
stories.why_it_matters: Relevant to commercialization and biotech regulatory strategy.
stories.caveat: Does not itself change approval standards or guarantee market exclusivity.
